# platform

```go
import "github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/pkg/oci/platform"
```

Package platform defines canonical CPU architecture identifiers and validation helpers used by cargoship when targeting specific platforms in OCI workflows.

## Constants

<a name="ArchAMD64"></a>These are the supported architectures.

```go
const (
    // ArchAMD64 is the amd64 architecture.
    ArchAMD64 = api.ArchAMD64
    // ArchARM64 is the arm64 architecture.
    ArchARM64 = api.ArchARM64
    // ArchRISCV is the riscv architecture.
    ArchRISCV = api.ArchRISCV
)
```

<a name="ValidateArch"></a>
## func [ValidateArch](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/oci/platform/core.go#L46>)

```go
func ValidateArch(format Arch) error
```

ValidateArch checks if the given platform operating system architecture format is valid.

format: the Arch to validate. error: an error if the architecture format is invalid, otherwise nil.

<a name="Arch"></a>
## type [Arch](<https://github.com/colonel-byte/cargoship/blob/main/pkg/oci/platform/core.go#L30>)

Arch names a CPU architecture an image volume can target. It aliases the API type so a package definition and an OCI platform cannot drift apart on what an architecture is.

```go
type Arch = api.Arch
```
